source_excerpt: 'Jailer 2', starring Rajinikanth, continued its impressive box office run on Saturday, October 31. The film collected Rs 9.35 cr net in India, registering a 70% increase over the previous day's earnings. Its domestic net collection has now reached Rs 444.75 cr, while the India gross stands at Rs 520.35 cr.The film has also maintained a strong presence in overseas markets. It earned Rs 3 cr from international territories on Day 17, taking its overseas gross collection to Rs 270.50 cr. This has pushed its worldwide gross to Rs 790.85 cr, as per Sacnilk reports.The film recorded 8,738 shows across India on Saturday. An estimated 6,92,764 tickets were sold during the day, taking the total number of tickets sold throughout its run to 3,00,11,397. The latest day's earnings contributed approximately 2.1% to its overall India net collection.'Jailer 2' registers a 70% jump in Saturday collectionsThe film witnessed a notable increase in collections after earning Rs 5.50 cr on Friday. Its Saturday performance was led by the Tamil version, which contributed Rs 6.70 cr through 4,199 shows.The Hindi version collected Rs 1.45 cr from 3,549 shows. Telugu screenings added Rs 90 lakh through 801 shows, while the Kannada version contributed Rs 30 lakh across 189 shows. The figures indicate that the Tamil version remained the biggest contributor among the four language releases.Weekly collections take India net beyond Rs 444 crDuring its first eight days, 'Jailer 2' collected Rs 334.35 cr net and Rs 391.55 cr gross in India. The second week added Rs 95.55 cr net and Rs 111.50 cr gross, representing a 71.4% decline compared with the opening period.The film earned another Rs 14.85 cr net and Rs 17.30 cr gross during the first two days of its third week. Its overall domestic business has now crossed the Rs 500 cr mark in gross collections.Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' stays ahead of 'Coolie'A comparison with Rajinikanth's previous release 'Coolie' shows a considerable difference in their box office performances. At the same point in its theatrical run, 'Coolie' had collected Rs 276 cr net and Rs 322.40 cr gross in India. Its worldwide gross stood at Rs 499.40 cr, including Rs 177 cr from overseas markets.On its 17th day, 'Coolie' earned Rs 2.80 cr net from 3,998 shows. The Tamil version contributed Rs 1.95 cr from 1,790 shows, while Telugu screenings collected Rs 45 lakh through 918 shows. Hindi shows added Rs 36 lakh from 1,209 screenings, and Kannada contributed Rs 4 lakh across 81 shows. Overseas earnings for the day stood at Rs 50 lakh.The film generated an average of Rs 7,004 per show on that day. In comparison, 'Jailer 2' has established a significantly higher domestic and worldwide total at the corresponding stage.Tamil version records the highest occupancyThe Tamil version of 'Jailer 2' registered 30.37% overall occupancy on Saturday. Morning shows recorded 17.46%, while afternoon screenings reached 29.92%. Evening occupancy stood at 31.54%, rising to 42.54% during night shows.The Hindi version reported 15.28% overall occupancy. Its morning, afternoon, evening and night screenings recorded 11.42%, 11.33%, 13.92% and 23.08%, respectively. Telugu shows registered 23.28% overall occupancy, with the night shows reaching 29.90%.Tamil Nadu emerged as the biggest contributor to the film's state-wise gross on Saturday. The state collected Rs 5.25 cr, accounting for 48.2% of the tracked domestic gross of Rs 10.90 cr.Karnataka added Rs 2 cr, while Andhra Pradesh and Telangana together contributed Rs 1 cr. Kerala also recorded Rs 1 cr, and the remaining Indian markets accounted for Rs 1.65 cr. The figures underline Tamil Nadu's contribution to the film's latest day's box office performance.
